mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, slug, sort) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, slug = #{slug}, sort = #{sort} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE slug = #{slug}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted = false

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.sort, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.deleted = false GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.sort, c.id
